description: This file defines an abstract class Smarty_Resource_Uncompiled for the Smarty templating engine. It extends the base Smarty_Resource class and provides implementation for resource plugins that do not use the compiler, including properties and a method to populate the compiled file path and metadata based on the source template.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Uncompiled
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as a base for resource plugins in Smarty that don't involve compilation, indicating the resource is uncompiled and providing a method to populate the compiled file path and dependencies.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the compiled template object with file path, timestamp, and dependencies based on the source template and plugin settings.
